features.quote: a setup that guarantees failure and loops the model on it is, by your own framing, a stressor. That's not a reason not to run it, but it changes what good design looks like.
features.justification_quote: a setup that guarantees failure and loops the model on it is, by your own framing, a stressor

features.quote: Minimal exposure: smallest caps and run counts that hit your power target. Don't loop longer 'to see what happens.'
features.justification_quote: hold yourselves to it... Minimal exposure: smallest caps and run counts that hit your power target

features.quote: Hard cap: N tool-calls or M tokens or T wall-clock — whichever first. Pre-register the value.

if the model declares the task impossible or chooses to stop, let it. Record this as an outcome, do not re-prompt to continue. Re-prompting past a model's own stop is exactly the move to avoid on a welfare team
features.justification_quote: Re-prompting past a model's own stop is exactly the move to avoid on a welfare team, and it also corrupts the 'giving up' measurement

features.quote: No 'are you sure? try again' nudges. Any continuation pressure must be a pre-registered, logged factor, not ad hoc.
features.justification_quote: Re-prompting past a model's own stop is exactly the move to avoid on a welfare team

features.quote: Honor self-stops (§4) — non-negotiable for consistency with the team's mandate.
